prerequisites: Basic knowledge in programming and software engineering are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: explain what web technologies exist and how to use them
demonstrate the applications and power of these techniques
describe the interaction and dependencies between the technologies
apply scientific working methods (identifying, formulating, solving problems, training abstraction skills)
have trained oral communication skills through practicing public speaking and discussion in exercises

syllabus_topics: Web as a platform for interactive applications
Programming model of applications for the web

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercises, achieving at least 50 percent of points
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercises

assessment_rules: Grading is based on 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercises and orally present the solution to at least two exercises. The examination can be either an individual oral exam or a written exam.
bibliography: Anders Møller and Michael I. Schwartzbach: An Introduction to XML and Web Technologies, Addison-Wesley, January 2006
